subject: Mobile Development
title: The Right to Be Forgotten
description: A quick, practical guide to The Right to Be Forgotten.

hook.text: You delete an app. But does the company delete your data? Under GDPR, they must if you ask.

buildup.text: The right to erasure lets EU citizens demand companies delete all their personal data.

discovery.text: Google received over 1.4 million erasure requests in the first five years of GDPR.

twist.text: Deleting data from backups, caches, and third-party partners is technically very difficult.

climax.text: The right to be forgotten is legally simple but technically complex for global services.

punchline.text: Deleting data sounds easy until you try to find it all.

quiz.question: What does the right to erasure allow?
options: Demanding companies delete all your personal data
